The claim explicitly excludes ties and non-null mixtures.

value.rationale: The source motivates multi-knockoffs by reducing the minimum rejection threshold. The exact result converts that design parameter into a precise finite-feature/global-null calibration law. At the same nominal \(q=0.1\), admissible choices have limiting null FDR \(0.1\), approximately \(0.02918\), or approximately \(0.00417\), so the result quantifies a substantive calibration consequence rather than merely rephrasing validity. It also yields exact implementation benchmarks and identifies when the published FDR bound is asymptotically sharp.
